property.name: SupportsBlendFactor
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.BlendFactor blend mode.
property.remarks: Constant color blending factor used by the frame-buffer blender.

property.name: SupportsBothInverseSourceAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.BothInverseSourceAlpha blend mode.
property.remarks: Source blend factor is (1 − As, 1 − As, 1 − As, 1 − As), and destination blend factor is (As, As, As, As); the destination blend selection is overridden. This blend mode is supported only for the SourceBlend render state.

property.name: SupportsBothSourceAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.BothSourceAlpha blend mode.
property.remarks: This mode is obsolete. For DirectX 6 and later, you can achieve the same effect by setting the source and destination blend factors to Blend.SourceAlpha and Blend.InverseSourceAlpha in separate calls.

property.name: SupportsDestinationAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.DestinationAlpha blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.DestinationAlpha blend factor is (Ad, Ad, Ad, Ad), where Ad is the destination alpha value.

property.name: SupportsDestinationColor
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.DestinationColor blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.DestinationColor blend factor is (Rd, Gd, Bd, Ad), where R, G, B, and A respectively stand for red, green, blue, and alpha destination values.

property.name: SupportsInverseDestinationAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.InverseDestinationAlpha blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.InverseDestinationAlpha blend factor is (1 − Ad, 1 − Ad, 1 − Ad, 1 − Ad), where Ad is the alpha destination value.

property.name: SupportsInverseDestinationColor
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.InverseDestinationColor blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.InverseDestinationColor blend factor is (1 − Rd, 1 − Gd, 1 − Bd, 1 − Ad), where Rd, Gd, Bd, and Ad respectively stand for the red, green, blue, and alpha destination values.

property.name: SupportsInverseSourceAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.InverseSourceAlpha blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.InverseSourceAlpha blend factor is (1 − As, 1 − As, 1 − As, 1 − As), where As is the alpha destination value.

property.name: SupportsInverseSourceColor
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.InverseSourceColor blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.InverseSourceColor blend factor is (1 − Rs, 1 − Gs, 1 − Bs, 1 − As) where R, G, B, and A respectively stand for the red, green, blue, and alpha destination values.

property.name: SupportsOne
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.One blend mode.

property.name: SupportsSourceAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.SourceAlpha blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.SourceAlpha blend factor is (As, As, As, As), where As is the alpha source value.

property.name: SupportsSourceAlphaSat
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.SourceAlphaSat blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.SourceAlphaSat blend factor is ( f , f , f , 1), where f = min (A, 1 − Ad).

property.name: SupportsSourceColor
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.SourceColor blend mode.
property.remarks: The Blend.SourceColor blend factor is (Rs, Gs, Bs, As), where R, G, B, and A respectively stand for the red, green, blue, and alpha source values.

property.name: SupportsZero
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the driver supports the Blend.Zero blend mode.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.
